models.addAllCurrentHint: Adds each {provider} model models.dev lists that isn't deprecated and produces text or embeddings. Models already in the catalogue are skipped; models.dev adding new ones later doesn't add them here.
models.addCount: {count, plural, =0 {Add models} one {Add # model} other {Add # models}}
models.addCustomHint: Give the provider's model id. If models.dev lists it, its values fill in; otherwise enter them.
models.addHint: Search models.dev. Prices, limits and capabilities come with each model; you can override them later.
models.addedCount: Added {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}}
models.alias.deleteHint: Requests that send this name are refused, unless a model has the same name.
models.alias.dialogHint: Apps send the alias as model and requests use its target, which can change at any time.
models.alias.emptyHint: A name apps send as model, like fast, for a model in the catalogue; retarget it and every app follows.
models.alias.shadows: Apps that send `{name}` get this alias, not the model with the same name.
models.customListed: models.dev lists {model}: its values are filled in.
models.customUnlisted: models.dev doesn't list it. Inputs, outputs, limits, input and output prices and the format are required.
models.delistedHint: models.dev stopped listing it; it keeps its last known values.
models.effortLevelsHint: The levels requests may send; none means the model takes no effort setting.
models.emptyHint: Requests may only name models in the catalogue; add them from models.dev with their prices.
models.noMatchesHint: Clear the filters to see the whole catalogue.
models.noneFoundHint: Try another name, or include deprecated models.
models.notFound: This model doesn't exist or was removed.
models.overrideNote: Saved values override models.dev for this project only.
models.problem.format: A custom model needs the format Kaeso sends it.
models.problem.limits: A custom model needs its context and output limits.
models.problem.modalities: A custom model needs its inputs and outputs.
models.problem.price: Prices are decimal amounts in USD, like 3.00.
models.problem.prices: A custom model needs its input and output prices.
models.problem.whole: Limits and the timeout are whole numbers.
models.removeHint: Requests naming it are refused, and aliases and model lists that name it lose it.
models.reviewHint: models.dev's values, completed by Kaeso. Values you change are saved as overrides for this project.
models.sendsAsHint: The format Kaeso sends to the provider.
models.timeoutHint: Empty uses the instance's request timeout.
